summary.text:
# 措辞强烈的来信 / A Strongly Worded Letter

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/federations_events_1.txt:184-1700`；`common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:620`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 银河社群决议通过后，其 effect 调用对应的 federations.10xxx 事件，发给正处于违规的成员国；之后每十年 federations.10400（隐藏）检查是否仍违规，30+随机330天后发出 10401「措辞强硬的信」。
  When a Galactic Community resolution passes, its effect fires the matching federations.10xxx event at members in breach; every decade hidden federations.10400 checks for continuing breach and, 30 days + random 330 later, sends 10401 "A Strongly Worded Letter".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 10100「高级异种研究」：决议禁止禁用AI或对前超光速文明持不干涉政策；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10100 "Advanced Xenostudies": the resolution bans outlawing AI and non-interference policies toward pre-FTLs; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10110「伦理准则重构」：决议要求采用最强的领袖强化政策；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10110 "Ethical Guideline Refactoring": the resolution requires the most powerful Leader Enhancement policy; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10200「五年计划」：决议禁止“基本维生”生活水准；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10200 "Five Year Plans": the resolution bans the Basic Subsistence living standard; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10220「中庸之道」：决议禁止“体面条件”“学术特权”生活水准与一切奴役；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10220 "Balance in the Middle": the resolution bans Decent Conditions, Academic Privilege and all slavery; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10230「普遍繁荣令」：决议禁止共担、乌托邦、化学极乐、强制宠溺以外的一切生活水准；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10230 "Universal Prosperity Mandate": the resolution bans all living standards except Shared Burdens, Utopian Abundance, Chemical Bliss and Mandatory Pampering; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10300「敬畏生命」：决议禁止“允许”的清洗政策；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10300 "Reverence for Life": the resolution bans the Allowed purge policy; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10310「独立法庭」：决议禁止“无差别”战争政策；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10310 "Independent Tribunals": the resolution bans the Indiscriminate war policy; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10320「最后手段原则」：决议禁止“无限制战争”政策；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
  10320 "Last Resort Doctrine": the resolution bans the Unrestricted Wars policy; the window usually offers comply (change policy), retain (stay in breach, a unity reward for some empires) and refuse (xenophobes).
- 10330「复员倡议」：决议禁止“军事化经济”政策；窗口选项通常为“遵守”（修改政策）、“保留”（统一入违规，部分帝国得团结奖励）与“拒不服从”（排外者）。
